description: List the members of the brand's Discord server a page at a time (limit 1 to 1000, default 100; pass the returned nextAfter as after for the next page), each with their id, name and roles. Discord only hands the full list to a bot with the Server Members intent switched on; when it refuses, the answer says so, and search_discord_members still finds people by name. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several
